title: ROOT CAUSE: sampling-plan/BES poll loops never wait - every page carries a crumb
description: The WhileController polls while crumb_token == CRUMB_NOT_FOUND, on the documented assumption that the 'still scanning' status page has no crumb field. That assumption is false. Captured response body from perf-test (/accreditation/sampling-plan/{id}/status, meta-refresh + status-message present, 13737 bytes) contains name="crumb" exactly once and the loop's own extractor regex matches it. All 45 captured pages in a full journey match it. So crumb_token is populated on the very first poll, the condition goes false immediately, and the loop has ALWAYS run exactly one iteration - it has never waited for a scan. Threads pass only if the scan happens to finish inside that single 2s window; under load most do not, producing the 400 at step 22 (36/50 reported, 34/49 reproduced). Fix: poll on http-equiv="refresh" instead, which is present on both sampling-plan and BES status pages and absent on both ready pages. The misleading comment in the jmx files should be corrected too.
notes: WHY NOW - ANSWERED by cdp-app-config history. Timeline (all BST): 28 Aug 16:43 (3c1dc938) perf-test frontend set API_STUB_ENABLED=true; 30 Aug 09:27 (400c5778) backend ReExApi__UseStub=true; 30 Aug 15:21 MY CLEAN BASELINE RUN - 2825 samples, 0 errors; 30 Aug 17:13 (1dade7c6) API_STUB_ENABLED=false + API_BASE_URL pointed at the real perf-test backend; 31 Aug 06:49 (c510cdc3) added CdpUploader__Url and CaseWorking__UseStub=false. So the clean baseline ran while the frontend used its in-memory stub client, where stubCompleteUpload marks uploads complete SYNCHRONOUSLY - the scan was always ready on the first poll, so the crumb bug (loop exits after one poll) was harmless. Two hours later perf-test switched to the real backend -> real CDP uploader -> real ClamAV -> real SQS, which is genuinely asynchronous, and the latent bug began producing the 400s. Corollary: the Amazon.SQS exceptions appearing 'only now' are consistent with real uploader/SQS traffic starting for the first time in perf-test (CdpUploader__Url wired 31 Aug), not with SQS breaking - cdp-uploader itself is unchanged since 19 Aug and the perf-test proxy config is unchanged. The 400 is a test bug exposed by a config change, not a platform regression.

title: Fix sampling-plan scan-wait: assert completion, handle upload=failed, real PDF, configurable poll cap
description: Step 22 POST sampling-plan results returns 400 (noCleanFile) when the virus scan has not produced a Clean file. The poll loop exits on 'a crumb appeared', which is also true of /results?upload=failed, and step 21 has no assertion, so failures surface as a confusing 400 at step 22. Fixes: (1) assert scan completion after the poll, (2) treat upload=failed as failure, (3) replace the 33-byte fake sampling-plan.pdf with a valid PDF, (4) parameterise the 12-poll cap.
notes: Applied: (3) real 613-byte valid PDF replaces 33-byte stub (pdf+application/pdf both allow-listed); (4) 9 poll caps -> ${__P(scan_poll_max,30)} across 4 plans; (1)+(2) inserted 7x '21b GET sampling-plan results (verify scan completed)' samplers asserting data-testid=uploaded-files-table present AND data-testid=error-summary absent, plus crumb re-extraction from the verified page. BES-evidence poll loops (exporter:1230, operator-accreditation:1201) got the cap fix only - assertion pattern for those is follow-up.
close_reason: All 4 fixes applied and verified end-to-end on perf-test: reprocessor 56 samples/0 failures, exporter 99 samples/0 failures. 21b also correctly caught a genuinely incomplete scan on one run. Committed as 566f79e on branch fix/sampling-plan-scan-verification; push blocked on SSH passphrase (see follow-up).

title: Perf runs all share stub-op-1, triggering the RA-462 concurrent-login banner on every page
description: epr-register-enrol-frontend defines exactly ONE operator stub identity (stub-op-1) - confirmed against origin/main. Every JMeter thread therefore signs in as the same identity, so RA-462's concurrent-login notice fires for every session and its dismiss form (action=/auth/session-notice/dismiss) puts a crumb on 45 of 47 pages, including the sampling-plan /status page. That silently invalidated the scan-wait poll loop (see fe-perf-tests-480). The loop is now fixed to poll on meta-refresh so it no longer depends on crumbs, but two issues remain: (1) one shared identity across 50 concurrent users is not realistic load, and (2) the banner markup is present on every response in every perf run. Proposal: add a pool of stub operator identities (stub-op-1..N) in epr-register-enrol-frontend and have the jmx pick one per thread via __threadNum, so threads do not collide on a single identity. Note this requires a change in the frontend repo, not the perf-tests repo.

title: Reprocessor fixture pool EXHAUSTED (100/100); CSV only reshuffles, never regenerates
description: Perf runs consumed 51 of the 100 one-shot reprocessor fixtures (60001 and 60086 plus the 50 from a 50-user run). accreditation-reprocessor-fixtures.csv is only reshuffled by generate-accreditation-fixtures.sh, never regenerated with fresh orgs, so a consumed org can land at row 1. A users=1 run then hits an already-Submitted application whose page renders read-only with no crumb field, and step 12 POST tonnage-cya fails 403 - which looks like a bug but is fixture exhaustion. Options: track consumed fixtures and exclude them from the shuffle, expand the stub org pool beyond 100, or add a preflight that skips non-Saved fixtures. Remaining free reprocessor orgs: 60003, 60005, 60007, 60009, 60010, 60011, 60013, 60014, 60015, 60017, 60020, 60021, ...
notes: EXHAUSTED: reprocessor pool 60001-60100 is now 100/100 consumed (49-user profile run on 2026-09-18 took the last 49). No further reprocessor testing possible against perf-test until the pool is expanded or consumed fixtures are reset. Exporter pool 61001-61100 remains ~97 free. This now blocks diagnosis of the step-21 single-poll behaviour on the reprocessor plan.

title: Apply scan-verification assertions to BES-evidence poll loops
description: The sampling-plan poll loops now have a '21b ... (verify scan completed)' sampler asserting the uploaded file is listed and no error summary is present. The two BES-evidence poll loops (accreditation-exporter-journey.jmx:1283, operator-accreditation-journey.jmx) received only the configurable-cap fix, not the verification sampler, so a failed/incomplete BES scan still surfaces as a confusing downstream error rather than a named assertion failure. Mirror the 21b pattern for upload-bes-evidence: GET the cya/evidence page after the poll, assert the file is listed and no error summary, re-extract the crumb.
notes: SCOPE NARROWED: the only profiles actually run are accreditation-reprocessor and accreditation-exporter. Of the two BES-evidence poll loops, only the one in accreditation-exporter-journey.jmx is in a run profile - that one still needs the 21b verification pattern. The other (operator-accreditation-journey.jmx) belongs to the 'operator-accreditation' profile which is not run, so it is not urgent. Note both BES loops already received the scan_pending fix in bd6a8d0; what is outstanding is only the post-loop verification sampler.
